title: 第3课 · 左边那个红色的是我的
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 3 — 左边那个红色的是我的 · The red one on the left is mine

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在房间 — In the room

items.py: A: Zhè kuài shǒubiǎo shì nǐ de ma?
B: Bú shì wǒ de. Shì wǒ bàba de.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在家里 — At home

items.zh: A：这是今天早上的报纸吗？
items.py: A: Zhè shì jīntiān zǎoshang de bàozhǐ ma?
items.en: A: Is this this morning's newspaper?

items.py: B: Bú shì, shì zuótiān de.

items.zh: A：你听，是不是送报纸的来了？
items.py: A: Nǐ tīng, shì bu shì sòng bàozhǐ de lái le?
items.en: A: Listen — is that the newspaper delivery?

items.zh: B：我看一下。不是，是送牛奶的。
items.py: B: Wǒ kàn yíxià. Bú shì, shì sòng niúnǎi de.
items.en: B: Let me see. No, it's the milkman.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在家里 — At home

items.py: A: Zhè shì shéi de fángjiān?

items.zh: B：这是我和我丈夫的，旁边那个小的房间是我女儿的。
items.py: B: Zhè shì wǒ hé wǒ zhàngfu de, pángbiān nàge xiǎo de fángjiān shì wǒ nǚ'ér de.
items.en: B: It's my husband's and mine. The small one next to it is my daughter's.

items.zh: A：你女儿的房间真漂亮！都是粉色的。
items.py: A: Nǐ nǚ'ér de fángjiān zhēn piàoliang! Dōu shì fěnsè de.
items.en: A: Your daughter's room is so pretty! It's all pink.

items.zh: B：是啊，粉色是我女儿最喜欢的颜色。
items.py: B: Shì a, fěnsè shì wǒ nǚ'ér zuì xǐhuan de yánsè.
items.en: B: Yes, pink is her favourite colour.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在办公室 — In the office

items.py: A: Nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de bēizi le ma?
items.en: A: Have you seen my cup?

items.zh: B：这里有几个杯子，哪个是你的？
items.py: B: Zhèli yǒu jǐ ge bēizi, nǎge shì nǐ de?
items.en: B: There are a few cups here. Which one is yours?

items.zh: A：左边那个红色的是我的。
items.py: A: Zuǒbian nàge hóngsè de shì wǒ de.
items.en: A: The red one on the left is mine.

items.py: Zhè běn shū bú shì wǒ de.
items.en: This book isn't mine (= 我的书).

items.py: Zhège bēizi shì zuótiān mǎi de.
items.en: This cup was bought yesterday (= 昨天买的杯子).

items.py: Zhè kuài shǒubiǎo shì nǐ de ma?

items.en: The weather is really nice today!

items.py: Nǐ nǚ'ér de fángjiān zhēn piàoliang!
items.en: Your daughter's room is really pretty!

items.py: Sòng bàozhǐ de lái le ma?

items.zh: 旁边那个小的房间是谁的？
items.py: Pángbiān nàge xiǎo de fángjiān shì shéi de?

What is her daughter's room like?
